dct_title_s: Sherry Lake Quadrangle, Minnesota-Itasca County, 1964: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Sherry Lake quadrangle topographic map (N4737.5-W9307.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area west of Side Lake. The hand written notations include information on the following: South Ridge Line Railroad and logging camps noted with 'C'.
